system: Runtime Determinism / RSEL / E7 Queue Fixture
requirements: RSEL risk is Impact × Probability × Uncertainty.
Uncertainty must propagate consistently from input through reasoning, decision, and action.
Propagation mismatch must fail closed as FAILSAFE.

packages/queue/workers.ts.why: The explicit law-pass CI fixture hard-coded uncertainty 0.1 while accepted text IRL produces Q64_ZERO, causing the production-path fixture to freeze at RSEL.
packages/queue/workers.ts.spec_requirement: RSEL uncertainty propagation must be consistent across input and downstream layers.
packages/queue/workers.ts.old_behavior: NEXY_ALLOW_TEST_AGENT_FIXTURE=true plus NEXY_TEST_AGENT_FIXTURE=law-pass injected q64FromRatio(1n, 10n) as riskInputs.uncertainty.
packages/queue/workers.ts.new_behavior: The isolated CI fixture builder injects Q64_ZERO, matching the accepted-text IRL contract; production still receives no fixture and evaluateRisk remains fail-closed.
packages/queue/workers.ts.security_impact: No weakening; mismatch rejection remains unchanged. Only the explicit CI fixture was corrected.
packages/queue/workers.ts.determinism_impact: Improved: fixture uncertainty is now bound to the deterministic IRL result instead of an unrelated constant.
packages/queue/workers.ts.test_impact: Added regression coverage that builds the fixture, derives accepted-text IRL reality, and evaluates RSEL with the propagated uncertainty.

tests/integration/queue-boundary.spec.ts.why: The old worker boundary suite did not guard the CI fixture's RSEL/IRL propagation relationship.
tests/integration/queue-boundary.spec.ts.spec_requirement: Regression evidence must cover the exact propagation invariant.
tests/integration/queue-boundary.spec.ts.old_behavior: Malformed/stale payload behavior was covered, but fixture uncertainty drift was not.
tests/integration/queue-boundary.spec.ts.new_behavior: A third test asserts fixture uncertainty equals accepted-text IRL uncertainty and RSEL does not return the mismatch reason.
tests/integration/queue-boundary.spec.ts.test_impact: Queue boundary suite increased from 2 to 3 tests.

proven_gap: packages/queue/workers.ts used q64FromRatio(1n, 10n) for fixture uncertainty.
packages/intelligence/irl.ts returns Q64_ZERO uncertainty for accepted non-empty text.
packages/intelligence/rsel.ts rejects unequal propagated uncertainty with RSEL_UNCERTAINTY_PROPAGATION_MISMATCH.
Exact previous deployment 34e8fddc logged RSEL_UNCERTAINTY_PROPAGATION_MISMATCH and RELEASE_POLICY_FAILED.
